guard: A trusted platform issues only one assigned owner supervisor on the stock registration rail, with a strict administrative boundary, closed selectors, native renewal ceiling and finite credential lifecycle, and an ended assignment retires its gate and issued generations so held unexpired material is refused
why: Each named cell drives the real hosted auth service and built stock manager registration on a real broker. Each restore reruns the whole eight-cell suite. Registration JWT permissions are signed by the authority plane, not by the user-token callout.
